correctness.rationale: Legal permutations have determinant sign sum det(J-I-P), where J is all ones and P a cyclic shift. The constant-vector eigenvalue is n-2; nontrivial Fourier eigenvalues -1-zeta^k. The product vanishes for even n and yields n-2 for odd n. A legal transposition flips sign, so a bipartite Hamilton path requires parity-class difference <=1, excluding odd n>=5. For n=6 the certificate of 80 distinct indices into the exact lexicographic legal set was fetched from the frozen Git blob. Independent recomputation verifies each cyclic consecutive pair (including last-to-first) is one transposition, all 80 vertices are visited, 207 undirected edges and exhaustive all-source BFS gives eccentricity 5 for 48 vertices and 6 for 32. Exact enumeration also verified parity n=3..9; no finite extrapolation is used for unbounded odd n.

final_claim: For the legal ménage permutation transposition graph T_n, the even-minus-odd vertex count is n-2 for odd n and 0 for even n; thus no Hamiltonian path for odd n>=5. For n=6, an explicit cyclic 80-vertex Gray code exists and the graph has 207 edges, radius 5 and diameter 6; n=4,5 boundary components are determined.
limitations: Legal moves swap any two positions, not adjacent-position swaps; labels are not quotient by symmetry.
Odd-n parity theorem for all odd n>=5; Ham cycle only proven n=6; no connectivity inference for odd n.
